description: This file contains unit tests for gyp-mode in Emacs Lisp, including functions for fontifying files, comparing fontified outputs to golden samples, and testing the consistency of syntax highlighting.

methods.name: fontify
methods.description: Reads a filename, applies gyp-mode, fontifies the buffer, and returns the fontified string.

methods.name: read-golden-sample
methods.description: Reads a golden sample file and returns its content after reading from the buffer.

methods.name: equivalent-face
methods.description: Returns a face to ignore certain differences in face comparison.

methods.name: text-face-properties
methods.description: Extracts text properties (faces) from a string.

methods.name: create-golden-sample
methods.description: Generates a golden sample by fontifying a file and saving the output with text properties.

methods.name: create-golden-samples
methods.description: Recreates all golden samples for the test data files.
